turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. Thank you for coming in today. What brings you to the clinic?
turns.patient_response:
Well, thank you, Doctor. I came in because... lately, I've been having trouble just answering simple questions. I work as a jeweler, and when a customer asks me something basic, like when a ring repair will be ready, my answer just starts going all over the place. 

I'll start out trying to answer them, but then my mind just wanders out loud. I'll go from talking about the repair to our invoices, and then somehow I'm talking about garden soil, and then mortgage papers. I can literally see them losing me, just staring at me completely confused. It's getting really frustrating, and I just need to figure out why I can't seem to keep my words straight.

symptom_reasoning.S021: The patient describes their speech wandering illogically from ring repairs to invoices, garden soil, and mortgage papers, indicating derailment and disorganized speech.

turns.doctor_question: When you're talking and jumping from topic to topic like that, are you aware that you're doing it while it's happening, or do you only realize it afterward when you see people's confused reactions?
turns.patient_response: I think I realize it while it's happening. Like when they ask about that ring repair, I'll actually hear myself moving from that to the invoices, and then talking about garden soil or the mortgage papers. I know it's not what they asked, and I can see them getting lost right as I'm speaking. I just can't seem to rein it back in once it starts.

symptom_reasoning.S021: The patient describes jumping from topic to topic (e.g., from a ring repair to invoices to garden soil) and being unable to rein it in, which is characteristic of disorganized speech and derailment.

turns.doctor_question: Has this problem with jumping around while you're talking been happening your whole life, or did it start more recently?
turns.patient_response: No, it's definitely not something I've dealt with my whole life. This whole change really started... I guess it was not long after we took on the business mortgage. So, it's been going on for almost two years now.

turns.doctor_question: Over these past two years, have you noticed any changes in your mood or energy levels, or have you been feeling more irritable, more energetic than usual, or sleeping less than you normally do?
turns.patient_response: No, I haven't been more energetic or sleeping less. It's actually kind of the opposite. My mood has just been... well, most mornings I wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. It's hard to describe, but it feels like all the color has just drained out of the house before I even leave for the shop.

symptom_reasoning.S034: The patient explicitly denies being more energetic than usual.
